long_biography.plain_text:
Trips to New Zealand with trainer Bart Cummings shaped mining entrepreneur Michael O'Keeffe's interest in breeding racehorses. Cummings introduced him to the country's staying bloodlines, while visits with John O'Shea brought him into contact with Waikato Stud. O'Shea helped arrange the mating that produced Hall Of Fame, O'Keeffe's first Group One winner as a breeder.

His interest in horses began in childhood, with pony club and mustering camps near Mount Isa. As an owner and breeder, he has favoured keeping promising fillies for their future breeding potential. He bred Hall Of Fame from Around The Clock, a mare he had previously raced with Cummings.

confidence.reason: Full association interview supplies his own account of mentors, breeding decision, early riding and first Group One winner. Breeder credit is distinct from race-day ownership.
